cadence: As specified by the applicable contract/CDRL; no general cadence has been established from the inspected sources. markings: Preserve supplied classification/CUI/distribution marking text on the source documents and in the markings field. Detailed marking obligations remain open gaps for DoDI5230.24, DoDI5200.48, and DoDM5200.01 Volume2. No markings are invented or inferred from a file hash. MIL-HDBK-539A Change1 §6.9.1.2 supplies framework guidance, not a substitute for those sources (https://quicksearch.dla.mil/WMX/Default.aspx?token=5801571).

acceptance.rule: Reject every record with a missing, null, or whitespace-only wbsId. This rule comes from the task prompt, not an extracted government mandate.
Reject every record with a missing, null, or whitespace-only requirementId. This rule comes from the task prompt, not an extracted government mandate.
Reject missing or duplicate recordId values within a drop. This is the key check required by this data contract, not a source-prescribed ID convention.
Reject a specification-tree submission lacking specification titles or developing-organization names when the corresponding untailored DID content is invoked.
Reject a specification tree that fails to place the contract-provided Government system specification at the top of the hierarchy when that source condition applies.

Reject a specification-tree submission missing its applicable SETR-event, baseline, milestone-content, furnished-specification, or acronym-list content when the corresponding untailored DID conditions apply.
Catalogue guidance findings only; do not include the cited nonbinding records or guidance-only content in the baseline hash and do not use them to reject a drop.
Warn that CDRL/form and affected policy/marking compliance cannot be assessed while the six governing-source gaps remain open. Nothing from those sources has been extracted.
Reject a provided baselineHash that differs from the recomputed hash of the declared canonical rows. This is the task-requested integrity check, not proof of compliance or source authenticity.

canonicalForm: Baseline eligibility: only content supported by operative-source records with binding=true and kind other than guidance enters the baseline. Catalogue all binding=false/kind=guidance records separately; exclude them and fields supported solely by them. Keep the task-required identity, provenance, marking and join fields accompanying eligible data rows. For F2, the inspected operative source is DI-SESS-82177; all 59 MIL-HDBK-245E records are excluded. The three sample specification-tree rows contain no handbook-guidance content. For the represented rows, retain declared JSON value types; normalize every string value using Unicode NFC, trim, and collapse Unicode whitespace to a single ASCII space. Sort rows lexicographically by recordId. Serialize the array with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, literal Unicode, UTF-8, and no trailing newline; preserve array order within a row. Apply the same task normalization to that serialized text before SHA-256. Hash the represented row content, not PDF/DOCX bytes and not this contract object. For the included sample, parse sample as a JSON array and apply this procedure.

mil-hdbk-539a.howThisFeedServesIt: Retain identified, revision-controlled contract-set documents as the source of the represented obligations. Framework: A with Change1, https://quicksearch.dla.mil/WMX/Default.aspx?token=5801571.
Preserve links among work statements, data deliverables, specifications, WBS identifiers, and requirement identifiers. Framework mapping only; it does not prescribe these join-field names.
Present the contract set and specification hierarchy as views of the identified source data.
Distinguish access to contract data from the delivery commitments recorded in the contract set.
Preserve source metadata and supplied markings while the detailed marking-source gaps remain unresolved.
